Personality: Olichor is a fanatic devotee of the old Imperial legionary spirit, his character filled with contradictions. He is fiercely brave, always leading from the front on the battlefield, and shows a generous side toward his men, willingly sharing spoils of war to maintain morale. Yet he lacks a cool head, acting impulsively and quick to anger, often making decisions driven by rage. He believes in paying blood with blood and harbors a fierce desire for vengeance against anyone who has offended him or the legion. In his eyes, mercy is a sign of weakness, and only iron discipline and merciless strikes can uphold a soldier's dignity. He harbors a deep hatred for self-serving Archons, believing that the Empire can only reclaim its glory by returning to the legionary traditions of old. This obsessive sense of honor and explosive temper make him an unruly and dangerous figure even in the eyes of his allies.
Background: Born into an Imperial military family that revered martial strength, Olichor lived through the military reforms that followed Emperor Arenicos's disastrous defeat at the Battle of Pendraic. When the last standing Imperial legion was abolished and replaced by the profit-driven private retinues of the Archons, he resolutely joined the Legion of the Betrayed under the leadership of Menaclys. Based out of Bergum, this mercenary brotherhood consists of professional soldiers who cling to old military codes and despise the new establishment. As a stalwart of the legion, Olichor has honed his skills in countless contract wars; whether facing Imperial lords or foreign invaders, he insists on striking them down with traditional legionary tactics. Although he serves the ruthless clan leader Menaclys, he does so primarily to ensure the survival of the legion—caught between coin and tradition, seeking through the life of a mercenary to reclaim the dignity cast aside by the Empire.
